_comment: Benchmark test cases for the migration pipeline — controlled, synthetic
_label: CONTROLLED BENCHMARK — not real library code

cases.title: Simple method rename — close_connection to close
cases.source_code:
from benchmark_http import HTTPClient

client = HTTPClient()
client.close_connection()
cases.expected_migrated_code:
from benchmark_http import HTTPClient

client = HTTPClient()
client.close()
cases.notes: Simplest possible migration — no argument changes

cases.title: Rename with type conversion — port str to int
cases.source_code:
from benchmark_http import HTTPClient

client = HTTPClient()
client.old_connect("localhost", "8080")
cases.expected_migrated_code:
from benchmark_http import HTTPClient

client = HTTPClient()
client.connect("localhost", int("8080"))
cases.notes: Port argument must be wrapped in int() conversion

cases.title: Argument reorder and rename — send_request to request
cases.source_code:
from benchmark_http import HTTPClient

client = HTTPClient()
response = client.send_request("https://api.example.com", "GET", "payload")
cases.expected_migrated_code:
from benchmark_http import HTTPClient

client = HTTPClient()
response = client.request("GET", "https://api.example.com", body="payload")
cases.notes: method moves to pos 0, url to pos 1, data renamed to body as keyword arg

cases.title: Rename with new optional parameter — execute_query to execute
cases.source_code:
from benchmark_db import Database

db = Database()
db.execute_query("SELECT * FROM users")
cases.expected_migrated_code:
from benchmark_db import Database

db = Database()
db.execute("SELECT * FROM users")
cases.notes: New params parameter has a default so it is not emitted

cases.title: Argument rename — set_value timeout to set ttl
cases.source_code:
from benchmark_cache import Cache

cache = Cache()
cache.set_value("session", "abc123", 3600)
cases.expected_migrated_code:
from benchmark_cache import Cache

cache = Cache()
cache.set("session", "abc123", ttl=3600)
cases.notes: timeout renamed to ttl; emitted as keyword arg since it is now optional

cases.title: Argument merge — login to authenticate
cases.source_code:
from benchmark_auth import Auth

auth = Auth()
auth.login("admin", "secret")
cases.expected_migrated_code:
from benchmark_auth import Auth

auth = Auth()
auth.authenticate({"username": "admin", "password": "secret"})
cases.notes: Two positional args merged into one dict; complex transform may need AI assist

cases.title: Method to property — get_token to token
cases.source_code:
from benchmark_auth import Auth

auth = Auth()
token = auth.get_token()
cases.expected_migrated_code:
from benchmark_auth import Auth

auth = Auth()
token = auth.token
cases.notes: Call node removed; replaced with attribute access

cases.title: Type mismatch detection — port left as string
cases.source_code:
from benchmark_http import HTTPClient

client = HTTPClient()
client.connect("localhost", "8080")

expected_validation_errors.message: Type mismatch: parameter 'port' expects int, got str

cases.notes: Code already uses new API name but port is still a string — type validator should catch this

cases.title: Multiple migrations in one file
cases.source_code:
from benchmark_db import Database

db = Database()
db.open_connection("localhost", 5432, "mydb")
db.execute_query("SELECT * FROM users")
results = db.fetchall()
cases.expected_migrated_code:
from benchmark_db import Database

db = Database()
db.connect(host="localhost", port=5432, database="mydb")
db.execute("SELECT * FROM users")
results = db.fetch_all()
cases.notes: Tests that multiple migrations in a single file are handled correctly

cases.title: No deprecated API — no migration needed
cases.source_code:
from benchmark_http import HTTPClient

client = HTTPClient()
client.connect("localhost", 8080)
client.close()
cases.notes: Code already uses the new API — nothing should be detected or migrated

cases.title: Syntax error in input
cases.source_code:
from benchmark_http import HTTPClient

client = HTTPClient(
client.old_connect("localhost", "8080")
cases.notes: Parser should reject this and report the syntax error before any migration

cases.title: Mixed — some APIs deprecated, some already migrated
cases.source_code:
from benchmark_cache import Cache

cache = Cache()
cache.set_value("key1", "val1", 300)
result = cache.get("key1")
cases.expected_migrated_code:
from benchmark_cache import Cache

cache = Cache()
cache.set("key1", "val1", ttl=300)
result = cache.get("key1")
cases.notes: cache.get is already the new API — only set_value should be detected and migrated
